title: Migrate engineering models between declared profiles
description: Model maintainers can prepare and assess an explicit representation migration candidate while retaining the source interpretation and exposing intentional semantic changes and compatibility limits.

includes: Apply a supplied source-to-target mapping to an identifiable candidate.
Preserve identity and meaning or identify intentional semantic changes.
Assess target model rules and declared consumer compatibility before controlled adoption.
excludes: Automatic approval or adoption of a candidate.
Silent reinterpretation of historical states or universal format conversion.

sources.basis: IR-005 and its Scenario/SR analysis establish this bounded stakeholder capability; it remains draft analysis, not an implemented feature claim.
